subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Session and configuration runtime objects: a SessionManager owning the session object (phase discriminant, elapsed accumulators, countdown timer, network-comm interface and session-state dispatch list) with multiplayer auto-join, join, mode-setup, per-frame update and end-condition flows; a network object send dispatcher; a profile icon/setup-file list manager; a config/command-binding object destructor; game-mode and path-mode routers; session setup screens; session-flag UI rows; and the linked-list node / vtable-component primitives they share.

summary: Proposal for the generic_runtime_objects wave_002 packet 06. SessionManager (DERIVED from the packet's own owner label on 0x004643C0; extended at GUESS to the other session functions via the shared session-object fields obj+0x3FC4/obj+0x3FB8/obj+0x37C and the session globals dword_7CD25C/dword_7C56A0/unk_7CE24C) runs the per-frame session update, the auto-join retry loop, the session-type setup, the Game_Post flag setter, the end-condition check and the multiplayer join handler. NetworkObjectDispatcher (GUESS) creates and sends texture/data objects over the shared network-comm interface at obj+0x3FB8 via the 0x0057A6xx/0x0057A9xx send wrappers. ProfileListManager (GUESS) owns the icon/path linked list at this+0x444..+0x450, scanning player-profile icons, resolving the a2-th filename and loading setup files through the list owner sub-object at this+0x40. ConfigCommandObject (GUESS) is the command-binding config object destroyed at 0x00466A70. ProfileIconManager (GUESS) copies ProfileIcon.bmp and reloads the scene. GameModeRouter (GUESS) and PathModeRouter (GUESS) dispatch on dword_7D0410 and this+0x168 respectively. SessionSetupScreen (GUESS) groups the two session-mode UI parameter initializers sharing this+0x320. SessionFlagUIRow (GUESS) is the UI component constructor selecting one of six session-state pointers. ComponentObject (GUESS) and LinkedListNode (GUESS) capture the shared vtable-dispatch sub-object at this+0x40 and the uniform data/next/flag node layout. Contradictions are recorded in unresolved: obj+0xE4 is read as a source directory by 0x0046CD20 but as a float countdown timer by 0x0046DE10; the GlobalFlagBasedStateSetter target region falls outside declared fields; and several packet globals marked read never appear in their raw bodies.

function_roles.role: Creates a texture/data COM object through the vtable at interface+0x60 on the network comm interface at obj+0x3FB8, sets or overrides the object type, derives send code and flag from the type selector (1->code 1, 2->code 2 flag 1, else code 0), computes the send payload length as ((flag_word>>8)&0x3FF)+8, dispatches the object through the send wrapper (returns 1 when the dispatch returns zero), and releases the temporary object.

Multiplayer auto-join retry loop gated on the auto-join byte at obj+0xC6: selects championship mode from dword_7D0410 clamped against dword_7D041C/dword_7D0418, runs a QPC-timed retry loop polling session state; on ready (SessionStateCheck(this)==3) builds the session descriptor, requests a unique ID, writes path/session config, resets every stride-4656 vehicle slot via SessionStateTransition(-1,0), zeroes the vehicle count, rebuilds the active-vehicle pointer array and dispatches client team-select (returns 1); on timeout or unrecoverable state logs and returns 0.

Initializes the game session type and network configuration: reads the session discriminant at obj+0x3FC4 through the base pointer at this+0, delegating to sub_45ECD0 when zero; otherwise selects online mode (dword_7C56A0=3) versus offline mode (2), builds the network-communication strings from the session name and path defaults when byte_7CE260 is clear, marks the session active (obj+0x28=1, obj+0x3FD8=8, obj+0x3FD9=0), maps dword_7D0E50 through the jump table to a clamped size, copies online-mode configuration, calls CollisionInvDistanceStore, clears obj+0x30, initializes flags and returns sub_45ECD0. Called from Game_Init (0042d6b0).

Per-frame session lifecycle/scoring update: when the session phase id at obj+0x3FC4 is nonzero, adds the frame delta (dbl_8AFE98) to the obj+0x388 elapsed accumulator (or to obj+0x384 on the network-setup states), runs a network-comm-gated block gated on obj+0x3FB8 (player-slot sync, collision timestep/iteration, grid/track-opening timers, ServerOK request via obj+0x28, track-open signal via obj+0x29) or a comm-not-ready countdown at obj+0x37C, always advances the secondary accumulator at obj+0x384, drains the session-state dispatch list at obj+0x1B770, conditionally dispatches a string payload and hands the object to the mouse input handler.

Session flag setter called from Game_Post: when the init guard byte_7CE260 is clear it builds the track configuration name into byte_7CE498, conditionally runs a short computation and a guarded init on the object at *this, calls the single-function wrapper with the dword at obj+0x3FB8, then reads the object state bytes at obj+0xC5 and obj+0xC6 and sets the persistent session flag byte_7CE25F to 1 if either is nonzero; the flag is never cleared here.

Destructor for a config/command-binding object: copies the stored command-binding handle from the global table dword_7C7368 using this+0x108 as the index into this+0x104, resets the shared string buffer byte_5EA438, optionally reports the vehicle statistics in byte_7C56C0 when the scene-destroyed flag byte_7C7064 is clear, frees the linked list rooted at this+0x44 (nodes with data at node+0, next at node+4, flag byte at node+8), clears head/tail/count at this+0x44/+0x48/+0x4C/+0x50 and reinserts the aCustom_0 sentinel default entry.

Rebuilds the player-profile icon list: destroys the existing node chain at this+0x444 (nodes with data at +0, next at +4, flag at +8), sets the settings directory from dword_5EC440 or the byte_5EA438 default, iterates directory entries, formats 'dir+name' paths, strips each to its directory, appends the icon filename refreshed via BinarySearchInStringTable against aProfileiconBmp, loads icons via sub_497AD0 with aProfileiconDft fallback, appends (icon node, path node) pairs to the list, finalizes head/cursor and returns SetupFileLoadAndFinalize(this).

Resolves the a2-th filename from the linked list rooted at this+0x444 under the element-count guard at this+0x450: walks node next pointers (node+4), copies the leaf string (node+0 dereferenced) into the buffer at this+836, truncates at the first '.' and returns a pointer past the last '\' for the bare filename; bounds failures, null nodes or empty leaves return byte_5EA438.

Loads a setup file: obtains an index/token via GuardedAccessor, retrieves the setup filename from the list owner sub-object at this+0x40 through FilenameFromLinkedList, returns 0 on an empty name, copies and strips the extension, normalizes paths, resolves the season path global dword_7D0434 (or the default), dispatches the file-copy check, looks the combined path up via ObjectIDLookupAcross9Arrays, loads and decodes the audio file, retrieves two sub-objects from this[16] via vtable slot 28 (args 29 and 2), processes the first via sub_470190, finalizes the second and returns 1.

Copies the profile icon bitmap into a destination path built from this[57] (byte offset 0xE4) or the byte_5EA438 default plus the appended 'ProfileIcon.bmp' literal: removes any stale linked-list node keyed by the destination, verifies the source via sub_497AD0, isolates the filename, copies with CopyFileA (fail-if-exists), dispatches scene reload through the dword_7CD8C0 command interface (command 17 -> scene-name accessor and track config loader; command 45 -> vtable+56 call), copies data-path strings via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, calls sub_4B0770(0) and returns 0.

Session end-condition checker: ORs qualifying-DSQ-not-disabled with sub_4D24A0 or session-type compatibility, qualifying-finished with its state set, race-laps-complete (dword_8ACF8C-1), a full-grid all-finished scan, and a phase/time condition into a boolean flag, then delivers it to the session object through the vtable callback at offset 56 on *this; returns 0.

Game-mode state router: updates the sound system via an indirect vtable call on dword_5EB10C when present, initializes the flt_5EA618 buffer, then switches on dword_7D0410 via jump table jpt_46D704: modes 1-3 dispatch the circuit-selection prompt, mode 4 chains a session-scene init and dispatches the resume prompt, mode 5 (only when SessionStateCheck(dword_7CD25C) returns 3) sets up a multiplayer session (UI lookup on this+0x40, entrant setup, config writeback, conditional season/track scene load, sets dword_5CC9E8); returns -1 on handled modes and 0 on the default.

Handles the multiplayer session join flow: decrements the countdown timer at this+0xE4 each tick while positive, polls the session object reached through this+0x40 via its vtable slot 28 (arg 34) and checks the FieldGetter result for a negative value; on validation failure it formats the session-id buffer, resolves and displays the join-failure page and returns -1; on success it runs the diagnostic logging block, walks every stride-4656 vehicle slot calling SessionStateTransition(-1,0), zeroes the vehicle count, rebuilds the active-vehicle pointer array, sets reconnect flags (byte_7C5690=1, dword_7C56A0=2), dispatches client team-select and returns 0.

Path-processing loop with a final conditional branch: strips one directory component per iteration from the dword_7C73E0 path string until it is empty, then branches on this+0x168: when zero it reads a settings setup file from the path and returns its result; otherwise it retrieves UI text via UIScreenTextAccessor(this) and runs PathNormalizerFileEnumeration on the path with that text, returning its result.

UI component constructor: runs the base UIComponentInit5, zeroes field 0xEC, sets field 0xF0 to -1, installs the vtable off_5A01A0 at offset 0x0, then selects one of six session-state pointers by index a2 (1-6) into field 0xE8 (unk_7CEB64, unk_7CEB7C, unk_7CEB94, unk_7CEBAC, byte_7CEBC4, unk_7CEBDC) or null for out-of-range; returns the initialized object.

Session-setup screen parameter initializer: stores the current RaceMode (dword_7D0410) at this+0x324 and a pointer to the UI index global dword_7CEAA4 at this+0x320, formats the indexed UI list item text into a local buffer, pushes it into the edit buffer, then resolves an object of type 19 through the dispatch interface at dword_7CD8C0 and compares its name against this when it exists; returns 0.

Computes a session-mode table address as 36*dword_7D0410+8188032 and stores it at this+0x338, stores the mode value dword_7D0410 at this+0x320, then when the address is non-null dereferences it, fetches the indexed UI list item, formats it into a stack buffer and returns the result of EditBufferStringUpdate on that buffer; returns the null address immediately otherwise.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.responsibility: Owns the session object: the phase discriminant, elapsed accumulators, countdown timer, network-comm interface, config bytes and the session-state dispatch list, and drives the per-frame update, auto-join retry, session-type setup, Game_Post flag setter, end-condition check and multiplayer join flows. Membership of 0x004637A0/0x00463F70/0x00464600/0x0046D0D0/0x0046DE10 is GUESS-level from the shared session-object fields and session globals; 0x004643C0 is DERIVED by the packet.

classes.name: NetworkObjectDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Creates and dispatches texture/data objects over the network through the shared comm interface stored at obj+0x3FB8: creates the COM object via the interface vtable, sets/overrides its type, computes the send payload length and dispatches via the send wrappers (0x0057A6xx), releasing the temporary object.

classes.name: ConfigCommandObject
classes.responsibility: Config/command-binding object: stores a command-binding handle looked up from the global table dword_7C7368 and owns a singly-linked node list of custom commands that is freed and re-seeded with a sentinel default entry on destruction.

classes.name: ProfileListManager
classes.responsibility: Owns the player-profile icon/path linked list at this+0x444..+0x450 and the setup-file list owner sub-object at this+0x40: scans profile icons from the settings directory, resolves the a2-th filename from the list, and loads setup files through the list owner. Membership of 0x004693E0 and 0x00469630 is GUESS-level from the shared list fields and the call chain 0x00469630 -> 0x004693E0.

classes.name: ProfileIconManager
classes.responsibility: Copies the profile icon bitmap file into the managed ProfileIcon.bmp destination, removes the stale list node, reloads the scene/track configuration through the command interface and refreshes data-path strings. Single-method GUESS class; the source directory is read from this+0xE4, an offset also interpreted as a countdown timer by 0x0046DE10 (see unresolved).

classes.name: GameModeRouter
classes.responsibility: Routes the game-mode switch on dword_7D0410: circuit-selection prompts for modes 1-3, session-scene init plus resume prompt for mode 4, and multiplayer session setup for mode 5. GUESS class; the owner object is UNKNOWN in the packet and the UI-dispatch character is retained.

classes.name: PathModeRouter
classes.responsibility: Processes the module-callback-table path global dword_7C73E0 by stripping directory components, then branches on this+0x168 between a settings-setup-file read and a UI-text-driven path normalization/file enumeration.

classes.name: SessionFlagUIRow
classes.responsibility: UI component that selects one of six session-state pointer targets by index into field 0xE8; installs the off_5A01A0 vtable and initializes fields 0xEC/0xF0. GUESS class derived from the constructor-only packet body.

classes.name: SessionSetupScreen
classes.responsibility: Session-setup screen parameter initializer: stores the current race/session mode and UI index into this+0x320/+0x324, computes and stores the session-mode record table address at this+0x338, and drives the indexed UI list item into the edit buffer. Membership of 0x00470F20 is GUESS-level from the shared this+0x320 field and the identical UIListIndexedAccessor/format/edit-buffer call chain.

classes.name: ComponentObject
classes.responsibility: Polymorphic sub-object reached through the parent's this+0x40 slot (and through the parent object base this+0x0 in the vtable-callback case): exposes a vtable whose slot 28 (byte offset 0x1C) is a dispatch/factory method invoked with an argument that selects the requested object or command (args 34, 29, 2, 17, 24, 45, 19 across the packet).

classes.name: LinkedListNode
classes.responsibility: Uniform singly-linked node layout shared by the profile icon/path list and the config command list: data pointer at +0, next pointer at +4, flag byte at +8. Fields are kept per-base because the packet proves the layout only through distinct pointer expressions: the profile list inner node base *(*(this+0x444)+0x4), its leaf string base *(*(*(this+0x444)+0x4)+0x0), the profile tail base *(this+0x448), the config head base *(this+0x44) and the config tail base *(this+0x48). The class-level merge across these bases is GUESS, justified by the uniform node description in the packet.

classes.name: SessionDispatchListNode
classes.responsibility: Node of the session-state dispatch list rooted at obj+0x1B770: the head node carries its payload at +0 and a state byte at +8 (cleared before unlink); the packet only evidences the +0 payload field.

transitions.trigger: auto-join enabled byte at obj+0xC6 is non-zero
SessionStateCheck(this) returns 3 (ready to join); build session descriptor and request unique ID
valid unique ID: reset stride-4656 vehicle slots, zero count, rebuild active-vehicle array, dispatch client team-select; returns 1
session init state dword_5CC9E8 becomes -1, or elapsed exceeds flt_7D0F28, or EnumToEnumTranslator returns non-zero
non-recoverable failure (state != 3): dispatch auto-join failure message, returns 0
session phase id at obj+0x3FC4 transitions from 0 to non-zero; frame delta added to obj+0x388
session phase id equals 1 or 2; frame delta added to obj+0x384 instead and network-comm block runs
network comm not ready: obj+0x37C countdown exhausted triggers a global state transition
qualifying DSQ not disabled and sub_4D24A0 true, or session-type compatibility with *(dword_7C54E8+16484)==3
session type 7 and player vehicle finished with its state set
session type 5 with laps remaining and lap counter reaching dword_8ACF8C-1
every vehicle in the dword_7C54F0 grid is finished after SessionStateCheckWrapper
phase dword_7C56A8 is 8 or 5 and flt_8ACF94 < dbl_8AFEA0
dword_7D0410 is 1, 2 or 3: dispatch the circuit-selection prompt
dword_7D0410 is 4: chain session-scene init and dispatch the resume prompt
dword_7D0410 is 5 and SessionStateCheck(dword_7CD25C) returns 3: setup entrant, write config, conditionally load season/track scene, set dword_5CC9E8

interfaces.name: IObjectDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Vtable-slot-28 (byte offset 0x1C) thiscall dispatch used to obtain sub-objects and commands from the ComponentObject at this+0x40 and from the global command interface dword_7CD8C0; the argument selects the requested object/command (34, 29, 2, 17, 24, 45, 19 observed). Concrete callees are indirect and not present in the packet.

interfaces.name: INetworkObjectSend
interfaces.purpose: Network object send protocol over the comm interface at obj+0x3FB8: create (0x0057A680), set type / release (0x0057A690), dispatch (0x0057A6A0) for texture/data objects, plus the single-function send wrappers (0x0057A750, 0x0057A900, 0x0057A910, 0x0057A920) used by the session flows. Dispatches return 0 on success.

interfaces.name: ISessionStateQuery
interfaces.purpose: Session state query protocol: SessionStateCheck (0x00461CD0, gating the auto-join and multiplayer paths on return value 3) and SessionStateCheckWrapper (0x00461DB0, gating the end-condition full-grid scan) against the session object global dword_7CD25C.

interfaces.name: IUIListEdit
interfaces.purpose: Session-setup UI list-to-edit-buffer protocol: fetch the indexed UI list item via UIListIndexedAccessor (0x00487010), format it into a bounded stack buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F), and commit it to the edit buffer via EditBufferStringUpdate (0x0048B810).

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionPhaseByteContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The session object field at obj+0x3FC4 holds the session phase/state id: 0 means no active session (SessionScoringUpdate returns immediately, SessionTypeSetter delegates to sub_45ECD0), values 1 and 2 select the network-setup update path (frame delta accumulated into obj+0x384, comm-gated block), and any other value selects the active path (elapsed into obj+0x388). A replacement must preserve this encoding.

compatibility_contracts.name: NetworkCommInterfaceContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The network comm interface pointer at obj+0x3FB8 is used through the send wrappers 0x0057A6xx/0x0057A9xx/0x0057A750: texture/data objects are created via the interface vtable, typed, dispatched and released, and a dispatch returning zero is reported as success (return 1). The session functions gate their per-frame comm block on the same interface.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleSlotResetContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Both the auto-join retry loop and the multiplayer join handler reset the session by walking every vehicle slot from unk_5EC6E4 with stride 4656 to dword_7C54E4, calling SessionStateTransition(-1,0) on each, then zeroing the vehicle count dword_5C329C, setting byte_7C5690=1 and dword_7C56A0=2, rebuilding the active-vehicle pointer array via 0x0042BC80 and dispatching the client team-select page (aClientTeamSele).

compatibility_contracts.name: ProfileIconListContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The profile icon list is a singly-linked list rooted at this+0x444 with tail this+0x448, cursor this+0x44C and count this+0x450; nodes carry a data pointer at +0, a next pointer at +4 and a flag byte at +8, and list nodes pair an icon node with a path/string node. FilenameFromLinkedList resolves the a2-th entry by walking node+4, copying the leaf string into the this+836 buffer, stripping the extension at the first '.' and returning the bare filename past the last backslash.

compatibility_contracts.name: CommandDispatchInterfaceContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The dword_7CD8C0 command interface dispatches through its vtable slot 28 with an argument selecting the command/object: 17 (scene name accessor + track config loader after icon copy), 24 (season/track scene load in the multiplayer mode path), 45 (a per-command-object vtable+56 call) and type 19 (object whose name is compared against the session-setup screen). Concrete targets are indirect and must be preserved by the replacement dispatch layer.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionStateValueContract
compatibility_contracts.description: SessionStateCheck (0x00461CD0) on the session object global dword_7CD25C returns 3 to signal 'ready to join/active'; the auto-join loop, the game-mode multiplayer path and the join handler all gate their session setup on that exact value, and the join handlers also require a valid UniqueID from 0x004630D0 before resetting vehicle slots.

unresolved: All packet owners except SessionScoringUpdate (SessionManager, DERIVED) are UNKNOWN in the packet; SessionManager membership of 0x004637A0/0x00463F70/0x00464600/0x0046D0D0/0x0046DE10 and all other class assignments (NetworkObjectDispatcher, ConfigCommandObject, ProfileListManager, ProfileIconManager, GameModeRouter, PathModeRouter, SessionFlagUIRow, SessionSetupScreen, ComponentObject, LinkedListNode, SessionDispatchListNode) are GUESS-level proposals, not packet owner labels.

Conflict on this+0xE4: 0x0046CD20 reads it as a source directory path (ProfileIconManager), while 0x0046DE10 reads it as a float countdown timer decremented per frame (MultiplayerSessionJoinHandler). Common ownership of this+0xE4 across those two functions is not established; the two readings may be different enclosing objects.
The GlobalFlagBasedStateSetter target region (*this + 28132) in 0x00463F70 falls outside the declared field offsets and has no mapped field name; its byte offset is not tied to a packet field ref.

Packets mark several globals as read that never appear in their raw decompiled bodies and are therefore unaccounted: flt_59E5FC, aD_1/dword_5C3280, unk_5EC6D0 and dword_7CD8C0 for AutoJoinRetryLoop; dword_59F0A8, dword_7CD2A8, byte_7CE498, unk_7D0EAC and unk_7D0EB4 for SessionTypeSetter; flt_59E440 for SessionScoringUpdate and MultiplayerSessionJoinHandler; dword_7CD468 for the join handler; global 0x005BE860, 0x007CE498 and 0x008AD3B4 for SetupFileLoadAndFinalize; and callee FreeWrapper_7bcf plus globals 0x007CE498/0x007CE630 for CopyProfileIconBMP (the free wrapper is reached only indirectly there).

SessionScoringUpdate reads obj+0x1B774/0x1B778/0x1B77C per the packet but no read/write of them appears in the decompiled body; they are listed as SessionManager fields with access 'unknown' and trust UNKNOWN rather than forcing a meaning.
MouseInputHandler is invoked at the end of 0x004643C0 in the raw source but has no packet callee evidence ref; it could not be bound beyond source:raw.
The StringLengthCheckDispatch operand at obj+112528 (byte offset 0x1B790) has no packet field evidence ref; the packet field at 0x1B77C is 20 bytes earlier and is not the same offset.

The vtable-callback attribution of field:obj:0x00000038 in 0x0046D0D0 is ambiguous: the op is an indirect call (*(*this + 56))(this, flag), while the field ref names obj+0x38 (the session state field also gating 0x0046DE10); the two readings are kept but their equivalence is unproven.

The this+0x40 sub-object (ComponentObject) is dereferenced as a vtable component by 0x0046D6D0 (UI lookup), 0x0046DE10 (session poll) and 0x00469630 (setup-file list owner). This suggests one enclosing class, but common ownership is not proven and the offset is kept per-base per the field rule.

ProfileListManager's this+0x40 field is declared there while GameModeRouter also dereferences this+0x40; the same base/offset in two classes is recorded here rather than merging, because the packet does not prove they are the same enclosing object.

The list-node bases *(this+0x444) offset +4 (profile next) and *(this+0x448) offset +4 (tail next) versus the config-list bases *(this+0x44)/*(this+0x48) are merged into one LinkedListNode class at GUESS; the packet only evidences the exact pointer expressions declared as fields.
The 16312 (0x3FB8) interface offset and the exact object type created by 0x00462250 are not derivable from that function alone; the 0x57A6xx create/dispatch/release sequence is the only lock.

GameModeRouter's dword_7D0410 mode meaning, the SessionStateCheck return-3 semantics beyond 'ready', the identities of dword_5EB10C/dword_7CD25C/dword_7CD8C0 and the dword_7D0E50 dispatch values are unconfirmed.
The six session-state target globals unk_7CEB64..unk_7CEBDC are opaque; whether they are flag bytes or structs is not evidenced.

SessionSetupScreen's this+0x338 stores 36*dword_7D0410+8188032, implying a session-mode record table (36-byte stride), but the record layout is not evidenced and the role of the this+0x320/0x324/0x338 fields beyond setup is unknown.

dword_8ACF8C is assumed a lap count in the end-condition machine; whether it is a lap count or another race total is unresolved from 0x0046D0D0 alone, as are the vehicle-state offset roles (+13000, +16444, +16484).
0x0046E7F0 names its settings-read callee SettingsSetupFileRead in the raw source, but the packet callee list has no matching entry, so its address cannot be pinned from this packet.
The guard:0 vs guard:1 recording in 0x00468EE0 differs from the raw head test at this+0x444; the cursor offset association is a DERIVED reading.

Exact path-format string literals (aPlr_0, aProfileiconBmp, aCustom_0, aJoinSessionWas and the other diagnostic literals) have content not established by this packet; only their address globals are cited.
